newsitem.title: USA: Muni bond sales total $1.2 bln for Tuesday.
newsitem.headline: Muni bond sales total $1.2 bln for Tuesday.

text.p: Scheduled competitive and negotiated municipal bond sales for Tuesday are expected to total $1.2 billion in 37 offerings, according to Reuters Municipal Bond Information Group.
Competitive sales total $413 million in 24 sales. The largest is a $143 million Industry Urban Development, Calif., deal at 1400 EST.
Negotiated sales total $770 million in 13 offerings. The largest is a $260 million Jefferson County, Ala., issue through Raymond James.
A total of $133 million of deals are on Reuter's day-to-day calendar, meaning underwriters have said they may price the bonds Tuesday depending on market conditions.
